caption: The drawing features a tall, ornate metal weathervane or finial structure with a pig figure mounted horizontally near the top, supported by a crossbar with circular ends. The pig is rendered in shades of gray and light violet with subtle yellow highlights along its lower body, legs, and face. The crossbar and vertical rod that pierce the pig are gold or brass in color. Below the pig, the structure consists of a brownish, intricately decorated vertical shaft with scroll and leaf motifs, tapering down to a square, pedestal-like base with layered segments. On the bottom right of the image, there is a smaller, simplified illustration of a human figure in light pink standing next to the same finial, providing a sense of scale. The background is plain and off-white, and the artist's name, "Adolf Østbø," is written near the bottom right.
title: Weather Vane Finial
